column1: # Full-wave S-parameters for `em <pcb> design` (em_intent): openEMS FDTD of the copper of `nets` and ref_net, lumped ports at `ports`.
# The region follows the nets that carry a port and the listed parts; a support net (bias feed) is cut at its edge.
# Other nets are not modelled: list in parts every R/L/C that terminates a net you include (an open-ended net rings in the model).
# checks: S<i><j><=|>=<dB>@<f1>:<f2>, ';'-separated. Optional: parts (C5=1.5p;L2=3.3n;R4=0), ref_net, z_ref, margin_mm, kind (line|antenna),
# copper (thick|sheet; sheet for antennas), end_db (default 50), max_pulses (run cap in excitation lengths, default 4; the
# settled row judges convergence), z_cells (per dielectric, default 4), l_q (inductor Q at the band centre, default 50).
# Capacitors are series ESR-ESL-C (ARCH-067 by dielectric/package; design/caps.tsv overrides, as for pdn); inductors series L + ESR from l_q.
# Minutes per port (antennas tens of minutes): run at sign-off, not every loop.
